text.p: The shares of Crest Petroleum Bhd surged on Tuesday to track recent gains made by another energy firm, Trenergy (Malaysia) Bhd, dealers and analysts said.
But they gave differing reasons for the rise of Crest.
While Trenergy had been gaining since last week over speculation of an oil and gas contract in an eastern Malaysian state, market participants said they heard various reasons for the rise of Crest.
Senior officials at Crest and Trenergy were not immediately available for comment.
Around 0330 GMT, Crest was up 35 cents or 4.22 percent to 8.65 ringgit on the market's third most-active volume of 4.27 million.
Fifth most-active Trenergy was flat at 10.60 after earlier rising to a 12-month high of 11.10.
One equity trader said there was speculation that Crest is undergoing restructuring and that asset injections will follow.
Another trader said an overseas oil project in a former Soviet republic in central Asia will yield strong returns.
"There's news in the market that their petroleum venture in Kazakhstan will give them 10 time more than earlier forecasts," the trader said.
Some analysts said there were also rumours that Crest and Trenergy may be linked in future projects or in cross equity holdings.
